# Plan: Quickshell desktop-shell implementation (`dotfiles/quickshell/`)

*Generated by planner agent on 2026-07-27*

## Overview

Create a third desktop-shell implementation for this Hyprland dotfiles repo using Quickshell (QML), as a feature-for-feature migration of `dotfiles/ags/`. `dotfiles/waybar/` and `dotfiles/ags/` are left untouched. The motivation is lower resource usage and snappier behavior, so the implementation must lean on Quickshell's built-in native services instead of shelling out or polling wherever possible.

### Verified environment facts (checked on this machine)

- `qs` / `quickshell` binaries exist at `/usr/bin/qs`, owned by AUR package **`noctalia-qs` 0.0.12-1.4**, which `Provides: quickshell` and `Conflicts: quickshell`. `quickshell` itself is not in `pkglist-aur.txt` (nor is `noctalia-qs`).
- Installed QML modules under `/usr/lib/qt6/qml/Quickshell/`:
  - `Quickshell.Hyprland` — singleton with `workspaces`, `toplevels` (HyprlandToplevel: `title`, `workspace`, `activated`, `urgent`), `monitors`, `focusedWorkspace`, `focusedMonitor`, `dispatch()`.
  - `Quickshell.Services.Pipewire`, `Quickshell.Services.Mpris`, `Quickshell.Services.SystemTray`, `Quickshell.Services.Notifications` (full NotificationServer), `Quickshell.Services.UPower`, `Quickshell.DBusMenu`.
  - `Quickshell.Bluetooth` — adapters/devices with `pair`, `connect`, `forget`, `battery`, `discovering`.
  - `Quickshell.Networking` — NM-backed WiFi with `networks` (AccessPoint: `known`, `signalStrength`, `security`, `connect`, `forget`, `connectWithPsk`), `wifiEnabled`, `scannerEnabled`, `devices`. **Note:** this module may be a noctalia-qs fork addition; presence in vanilla `quickshell` must be re-verified at implementation time (see Risks).
  - `Quickshell.Io` — `Process`, `FileView` (with change watching), `Socket`, stream parsers.
  - `Quickshell.Widgets` — `IconImage`, `ClippingRectangle`, wrapper types.
- `qt6-multimedia` 6.11.1 is installed with QML plugin (`/usr/lib/qt6/qml/QtMultimedia`) → usable for YTM audio playback. `mpv` is NOT installed.
- `qmllint` is available; `qs` has **no** `--check` subcommand in this build (validation strategy adapted accordingly).
- Statusbar selection mechanism: `~/.config/hypr/user_settings/statusbar.sh` contains the bar name; `dotfiles/hypr/scripts/launchbar.sh` greps it (`ags` else `waybar`) and runs `$HOME/.config/$STATUS_BAR_TYPE/launch.sh`. `dotfiles/hypr/scripts/statusbar-switcher.sh` is the rofi switcher. Both would need small additions to know about quickshell — we do NOT edit them; the README documents the diffs.
- Dotfiles are deployed via GNU Stow (`apply.sh`) → `dotfiles/quickshell/` becomes `~/.config/quickshell/`, which is exactly quickshell's default config path (`qs` with no args runs `~/.config/quickshell/shell.qml`).

## Goals and scope

**In scope**
- New `dotfiles/quickshell/` implementing every feature of the AGS shell: top bar (Workspaces, Taskbar, ClientTitle, Clock+MediaBar center group, SystemMonitor, ToolsRow, Battery, SysTray, QuickSettings, PowerMenu), ControlPanel popup (main/network/bluetooth/audio pages, brightness slider, DND + notification list), CenterPopup (calendar + YouTube search | media player), notification popups, volume OSD, power menu button.
- Same visual style: Catppuccin Mocha palette, spacing, radii, pill shapes from `style.scss`, ported to a QML `Theme` singleton.
- Working YouTube Music integration reusing `ytm_bridge.py` verbatim protocol (one-shot: `python ytm_bridge.py '<json>'` → single JSON line on stdout).
- `launch.sh` mirroring AGS lifecycle, `README.md` documenting Hyprland config changes, `pkglist-aur.txt` addition.

**Out of scope / explicit deviations (documented in README)**
- MPRIS *export* of the built-in YTM player (AGS registers `org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.YouTubeMusic` via GJS DBus export). Quickshell QML cannot export arbitrary D-Bus objects. All in-shell controls work identically; only external `playerctl` control of the YTM player is lost. Every other MPRIS player is still controlled via `Quickshell.Services.Mpris`.
- The unused/vestigial AGS bits are not ported: `YouTubeMusicPopup.tsx` login flow references `YouTubeService.startLogin()` which does not exist in `YouTubeService.ts`, and `YouTubeMusicPopup` is not wired in `app.ts` (only `YouTubeSearch` inside CenterPopup is). Port `YouTubeSearch` only; skip the dead popup. (Confirm with user if login UI is wanted later.)
- GTK `Gtk.Calendar` is replaced by a QML calendar built from `QtQuick.Controls` `MonthGrid` + `DayOfWeekRow` (Qt6 has no drop-in calendar widget), styled to match.

## Architecture decisions

### 1. Directory / module layout (idiomatic Quickshell)

```
dotfiles/quickshell/
├── shell.qml                     # ShellRoot: Variants-per-screen Bar, OSD, NotificationPopups; ControlPanel; CenterPopup
├── launch.sh                     # process lifecycle (mirrors ags/launch.sh)
├── README.md                     # selection instructions + deviations + runtime-test status
├── ytm_bridge.py                 # copied as-is from dotfiles/ags/ytm_bridge.py
├── setup_venv.sh                 # copied from ags (creates .venv with ytmusicapi + yt-dlp)
├── .gitignore                    # .venv/, __pycache__/, oauth.json, browser.json, credentials.json, bridge.log
├── Theme/
│   ├── qmldir                    # singleton Theme
│   └── Theme.qml                 # colors, fonts, radii, spacing from style.scss
├── Services/                     # all `pragma Singleton` + qmldir
│   ├── qmldir
│   ├── Panels.qml                # popup visibility + control-panel nav page (replaces App.toggle_window + ControlPanelNav)
│   ├── Brightness.qml            # brightnessctl set + FileView sysfs watch (replaces BrightnessService.ts)
│   ├── SystemStats.qml           # cpu/mem/temp via FileView + 2s Timer (replaces SystemMonitor state)
│   ├── Tools.qml                 # hypridle/hyprsunset/record/monitor-suspend status polling (replaces ToolsState)
│   ├── NotificationStore.qml     # NotificationServer wrapper, popup timers, DND flag, list retention
│   └── Ytm.qml                   # bridge calls, yt-dlp URL extraction, MediaPlayer playback, queue/radio
├── Bar/
│   ├── Bar.qml                   # PanelWindow, exclusive, top-anchored; 3-section layout
│   ├── Workspaces.qml
│   ├── Taskbar.qml
│   ├── ClientTitle.qml
│   ├── ClockWidget.qml
│   ├── MediaBar.qml              # yt / mpris / empty switcher
│   ├── SystemMonitor.qml
│   ├── ToolsRow.qml
│   ├── BatteryLevel.qml
│   ├── SysTray.qml
│   ├── QuickSettings.qml
│   └── PowerMenu.qml
├── Panels/
│   ├── PopupWindow.qml           # reusable: full-surface overlay, click-outside + Esc close
│   ├── ControlPanel.qml          # StackView/StackLayout of the 4 pages

│   ├── NetworkPage.qml           # NetworkWidget + saved networks subview

│   ├── AudioPage.qml             # DeviceList output/input

│   ├── AudioEndpoint.qml         # volume row + expandable device list
│   ├── DeviceList.qml
│   ├── NotificationList.qml

│   ├── CenterPopup.qml           # calendar+search | separator | media player
```

Root `shell.qml` uses `Variants { model: Quickshell.screens }` for per-monitor Bar, OSD and NotificationPopups (AGS maps `app.get_monitors()` the same way). ControlPanel and CenterPopup are single windows.

### 2. AGS → Quickshell service mapping

| AGS (Astal) | Quickshell replacement | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| AstalHyprland workspaces/clients/focused | `Quickshell.Hyprland` singleton (`workspaces`, `toplevels`, `focusedWorkspace`, `activeToplevel` via `Hyprland.activeToplevel`/focused monitor) | Native IPC, no polling. Workspace focus via `Hyprland.dispatch("workspace N")`; client focus via `dispatch("focuswindow address:0x…")` |
| AstalWp (audio) | `Quickshell.Services.Pipewire` (`Pipewire.defaultAudioSink/Source`, `PwObjectTracker`, `node.audio.volume/muted`) | Volume icon computed in QML helper |
| AstalMpris | `Quickshell.Services.Mpris` (`Mpris.players`) | Position via 1s Timer, same as AGS ticker |
| AstalTray | `Quickshell.Services.SystemTray` + `QsMenuAnchor`/`QsMenuOpener` (DBusMenu) | |
| AstalNotifd (daemon) | `Quickshell.Services.Notifications.NotificationServer` | Quickshell becomes the notification daemon; swaync must stay killed (launch.sh). DND is a local flag in `NotificationStore` (notifd's dontDisturb equivalent) |
| AstalBattery | `Quickshell.Services.UPower` (`UPower.displayDevice`) | Hide widget when `!isLaptopBattery`/not present, like AGS |
| AstalNetwork + NM | `Quickshell.Networking` (present in installed build) | Ethernet toggle: keep `nmcli device connect/disconnect` via `Process` exactly as AGS does (AGS also shells out for this). See Risk R1 |
| AstalBluetooth | `Quickshell.Bluetooth` | `forget` replaces the nmcli-style delete; per-device battery available |
| AstalPowerProfiles | `Quickshell.Services.UPower` power-profile API if present, else `powerprofilesctl` via `Process` | Verify at implementation; qmltypes for UPower to be inspected then |
| GJS Gio subprocess/polls | `Quickshell.Io.Process` | Tools row scripts, brightnessctl, wlogout.sh, system-monitor.sh, cliphist.sh |
| GJS file reads (/proc, hwmon, sysfs) | `Quickshell.Io.FileView` (with `watchChanges` for backlight) | Less overhead than spawning |
| Gst playbin (YTM) | `QtMultimedia` `MediaPlayer` + `AudioOutput` | qt6-multimedia already installed |
| GObject state singletons | `pragma Singleton` QML objects | |
| scss classes | `Theme` singleton properties consumed by components | |

### 3. Theme port (`style.scss` → `Theme.qml`)

Export as readonly properties: the full Catppuccin Mocha palette (`base #1e1e2e`, `mantle #181825`, `surface0 #313244`, `surface1 #45475a`, `surface2 #585b70`, `overlay0 #6c7086`, `text #cdd6f4`, `subtext0 #a6adc8`, `subtext1 #bac2de`, `blue #89b4fa`, `mauve #cba6f7`, `red #f38ba8`, `green #a6e3a1`, `yellow #f9e2af`, `peach #fab387`, `sapphire #74c7ec`, `sky #89dceb`, `lavender #b4befe`, etc.), `barBackground rgba(30,30,46,0.3)`, `borderColor rgba(186,194,222,0.2)`, font family `"JetBrains Mono"`, and shared metrics: module radius 10, panel radius 16, pill radius 20, OSD radius 99 (pill), module margins 4–5px, paddings as in scss. Per-widget accent colors (cpu=sapphire, memory=mauve, temp=peach, clock=blue, powermenu=red, tools-toggle=sapphire, workspace-active=mauve on base, etc.) become properties or are referenced inline from the palette.

### 4. Popup windows

`PopupWindow.qml`: `PanelWindow` anchored to all edges, `WlrLayershell.layer: Layer.Overlay`, `exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore`, `color: "transparent"`, keyboard focus `WlrKeyboardFocus.OnDemand` while visible; a full-window `MouseArea` closes on outside click; `Shortcut`/`Keys.onEscapePressed` closes. Content `Rectangle` positioned via alignment + margins properties matching AGS (`control-panel`: right-aligned, top margin 40, right margin 5, 400×~800; `center-popup`: h-centered, top margin 40, width 800). Windows stay loaded but `visible: Panels.controlPanelOpen` etc. — same as AGS toggle_window semantics. Alternative considered: `LazyLoader` per popup to reduce idle memory; use `LazyLoader` with `activeAsync` bound to visibility for ControlPanel/CenterPopup as a free perf win.

### 5. YouTube Music (`Services/Ytm.qml`)

Keep the bridge protocol byte-for-byte (verified against `ytm_bridge.py` + `YouTubeService.ts`):
- Request: `.venv/bin/python ~/.config/quickshell/ytm_bridge.py '{"type":"search","query":{"query":"…","filter":"songs"}}'` (also `check_auth`, `radio` with `query=<videoId>`, `library_playlists`, `playlist`).
- Response: single JSON line on stdout: `{"type":…, "data":…}` or `{"error":…}`; `library_playlists` may carry both `data` and `error`.
- Implementation: one `Process` per request kind with `StdioCollector`, request-id guards replicating AGS's stale-response protection (`searchRequestId`, `radioRequestId`, `playRequestId`).

Playback: `extractAudioUrl` via `Process` running `.venv/bin/yt-dlp -f bestaudio -g https://youtube.com/watch?v=<id>`; feed URL to `MediaPlayer`. Port queue semantics exactly: `play()` resets queue unless invoked from `playCurrent`; `next/previous` (previous seeks to 0 if position > 5s); radio fills queue from `radio` response (filter tracks with `videoId`, map title/artist/last-thumbnail). On `MediaPlayer` EOS auto-advance is optional — AGS did *not* auto-advance (EOS just set isPlaying=false); replicate AGS behavior for parity, note as candidate improvement.

State exposed: `currentTitle`, `currentArtist`, `currentCover`, `isPlaying`, `position`, `duration`, `isLoggedIn`, `searchResults`, `isSearching`, `searchQuery`, `searchFilter`, `userPlaylists`, `libraryError`. `check_auth` on startup, then `library_playlists` (single-flight guard).

### 6. Notifications

`NotificationStore.qml` owns a `NotificationServer` (enable `actionsSupported`, `bodyMarkupSupported`, `imageSupported`, `persistenceSupported: true`). Behavior parity with AGS PopupManager:
- New notification → if `!dnd`, add to popup list with 5s timer; suppress Bluetooth "100%" battery notifications (same filter).
- Popup timeout/dismiss hides the popup (300ms slide animation) but keeps the notification in the tracked list for the control-panel `NotificationList` until the user dismisses it (call `n.dismiss()`), matching notifd.
- `dnd` toggle + "clear all" button.
- App icon resolution: `Quickshell.iconPath()` + `DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(appName)` once per notification (mirrors the AGS Apps fuzzy-query cache); prefer `n.image`, then app icon, then `appIcon`, then fallback `dialog-information-symbolic`.

### 7. Bar details worth calling out

- **Workspaces**: sorted by id (use `ScriptModel`/sorted JS array over `Hyprland.workspaces.values`), active = focusedWorkspace, click → `ws.activate()`/`Hyprland.dispatch`.
- **Taskbar**: `Hyprland.toplevels` sorted by `workspace.id`; icon from client class via `DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup` + `Quickshell.iconPath` with the `dev.zed.Zed → zed` substitution map; click focuses (`toplevel.activate()` or dispatch by address); tooltip = title.
- **ClientTitle**: `Hyprland.activeToplevel.title`, elided.
- **Clock**: `SystemClock` (Quickshell built-in, no Timer) formatted `hh:mm AP - dd MMM`; button toggles CenterPopup.
- **MediaBar**: 3-state stack (youtube / active-mpris / empty), filter excludes bus names containing `YouTubeMusic` (harmless to keep even though we no longer export it), active = first playing player; scrolling ticker for >25 chars driven by 1s Timer only while playing, with `(pos/len)` suffix.
- **SystemMonitor**: labels `  N%`, ` N.NG`, ` N°C` with the same hwmon discovery order (coretemp/k10temp/zenpower name match on temp1/temp3, fallback to first hwmon with temps); click launches `~/.config/hypr/user_settings/system-monitor.sh`.
- **ToolsRow**: reveal animation (300ms slide), buttons calling `~/.config/hypr/scripts/{cliphist,hypridle,hyprsunset,record,monitor-suspend}.sh toggle`, 2s status polling parsing waybar-style JSON (`class|alt|text`), active-state colors per scss; power-profile cycle button.
- **QuickSettings**: DND icon + volume icon, toggles ControlPanel.
- **PowerMenu**: runs `bash -c '~/.config/hypr/scripts/wlogout.sh'`.
- **Bar window**: `PanelWindow` top/left/right anchored, exclusive zone auto, background `Theme.barBackground` (translucent — quickshell surfaces support alpha).

    *Depends on:* all previous.

11. **Validation pass.** See Test strategy. Fix all qmllint errors; document warnings that are false positives (singleton resolution etc.).

## Risk assessment

- **R1 — `Quickshell.Networking` portability.** The installed provider is `noctalia-qs`; `Quickshell.Networking` may not exist in vanilla `quickshell` AUR builds. Mitigation: gate at step 5 — check the module in the target package; if absent in vanilla quickshell, either (a) document in README that the network page requires a quickshell build with the Networking module (noctalia-qs), or (b) fall back to an `nmcli`-driven `Services/Network.qml` (`nmcli -t dev wifi list`, `nmcli connection …`) behind the same widget API. Decision to be made when implementing; the widget should consume a thin service interface either way so the swap is contained to one file.
- **R2 — noctalia-qs 0.0.12 vs upstream quickshell API drift.** Property/type names differ between quickshell versions (e.g., Mpris `trackArtUrl` vs older names, Pipewire `ready` gating via `PwObjectTracker`). Mitigation: develop against the installed qmltypes (already dumped above), and qmllint against `/usr/lib/qt6/qml`.
- **R3 — Notification daemon ownership.** Quickshell's NotificationServer must own org.freedesktop.Notifications; if swaync or another daemon is running, registration fails silently. launch.sh kills swaync first; README warns.
- **R4 — YTM playback format.** `yt-dlp -f bestaudio -g` typically returns HTTPS googlevideo URLs (often webm/opus). Qt6 Multimedia uses the FFmpeg backend and should play them; if a format fails, constrain to `-f "bestaudio[ext=m4a]/bestaudio"`. Runtime test required (cannot be validated statically).
- **R5 — Tray menus.** DBusMenu rendering (`QsMenuAnchor`) is the flakiest area of any tray implementation; nested menus/action groups may need `QsMenuOpener` custom rendering. Budget extra time; acceptance is: left-click activate, right-click menu opens and items trigger.
- **R6 — Hyprland client focus/icon mapping.** `HyprlandToplevel` exposes title/workspace but focusing may need `Hyprland.dispatch("focuswindow address:…")` using the toplevel address; icon lookup by wayland `appId` via DesktopEntries can miss (same substitution-map escape hatch as AGS).
- **R7 — Popup click-outside behavior.** Layer-shell keyboard/pointer semantics differ from GTK; ensure the full-surface window actually receives pointer events outside content (it does when anchored to all edges with transparent background) and that exclusive keyboard mode doesn't trap input when hidden (`WlrKeyboardFocus.None` when invisible).
- **R8 — Stow deployment.** `~/.config/quickshell` will be a symlink into the repo; the venv (`.venv/`) and auth files then live inside the repo tree — `.gitignore` must cover them (AGS has the same situation).
- **R9 — Two shells fighting.** If the user runs AGS and quickshell simultaneously both will claim the notification daemon and render bars. launch.sh kills gjs/statusbar? No — leave AGS killing to the switcher; but our launch.sh should at least kill `statusbar`/`gjs` the same way ags/launch.sh kills competitors. Include `pkill statusbar; pkill gjs` mirroring the AGS script's aggressive cleanup.

## Test strategy

Static (all runnable here):
1. `qmllint -I /usr/lib/qt6/qml $(find dotfiles/quickshell -name '*.qml')` — must be error-free; triage warnings (unqualified singleton access warnings are expected noise; suppress via `pragma ComponentBehavior` / qualified names where cheap).
2. `qmlformat --check` if available, else consistent hand formatting.
3. `python -m py_compile dotfiles/quickshell/ytm_bridge.py` (should be byte-identical to the ags copy anyway — verify with `diff`).
4. `bash -n dotfiles/quickshell/launch.sh setup_venv.sh`.
5. Grep-audit parity checklist: every AGS widget/feature enumerated in this plan mapped to a QML file.

Runtime (limited; shell cannot run headlessly — be explicit in README/final report about what was NOT tested):
6. Smoke: `qs -p dotfiles/quickshell` from a terminal *inside the user's live Hyprland session* — this is the real test; if the agent session has access to the Wayland socket, attempt `timeout 10 qs -p … 2>&1` and check for QML load errors (even if windows can't be interacted with, load errors surface on stderr). If no Wayland access, state clearly: "config parses (qmllint) but was not runtime-tested; first `qs -p ~/.config/quickshell` run may surface binding errors."
7. Manual test checklist for the user (README section): workspaces click/urgent, taskbar focus, clock popup, media controls incl. YTM search→play→radio→next, volume OSD on key volume change, brightness slider, wifi connect/forget, BT pair/connect, notification popup + list + DND, tray menu, power menu, tools toggles, battery display, monitor hotplug (bar appears on new monitor via Variants).

## Success criteria

- `dotfiles/quickshell/` exists with all files above; `waybar/`, `ags/`, and `hypr/` untouched (git diff shows only new dir + one `pkglist-aur.txt` line + `.agents/` docs).
- qmllint error-free across all QML.
- Feature parity checklist fully mapped (every AGS widget has a quickshell counterpart or a documented deviation).
- `launch.sh` is executable and follows the ags lifecycle pattern; README documents selection steps that require no repo hypr-config edits.
- `ytm_bridge.py` identical to the AGS copy; bridge invocations match the protocol (`type`, `query` nesting, stdout JSON parsing incl. `error` field).
- `quickshell` present in `pkglist-aur.txt`.
